title: Figure 29: Ultrasound-powered neurostimulator construction; Fig. 30 glass microfluidics
description: Labeled cutaway schematic of a small encapsulated neurostimulator showing "Silver chloride electrodes (0.8 mm)," "encapsulation," "Diode (0.9mm)," and "piezoelectric polymer (variable length 1-5 mm)." Caption reads "Figure 29. Illustration of the Internal Construction of the Ultrasound Powered Neurostimulator Developed at ASU." Below is Figure 30, a blue-tinted photograph of glass microfluidic chips captioned "Microfluidics in Glass."
